existing_mapping.evidence: The ParkingLot class includes attributes for a unique number, name, address, and city.
The ParkingLot class possesses an attribute for available spaces to indicate if the parking lot is full.
There is an association between Client and Vehicle classes ensuring ownership of vehicles by a client.
ParkingSession class includes attributes for start time and vehicle details.
The ParkingSpace class has a size attribute that provides the size category the space falls into.
Conveyor class includes a maxWeightKg attribute indicating the maximum weight it can handle.
The end of the parking session indicates there is no ongoing tracking needed for conveyors handling vehicles.
ParkingLot class is associated with PriceList which details prices per hour and for a full day.
ClubMembership class exists representing a membership system managing clients' club data.
ParkingSession and ClubMembership classes interact to apply discounts, affirming fixed discounts for members.
ClubMembership class has logic to check if the parking session is the first in the registration month for determining free status.
AnnualSummaryReport class contains a yearly overview capability.
AnnualSummaryReport class aggregates information such as income and vehicle count for each parking lot.
AnnualSummaryReport class contains a method to sort results by city and total amount received.
AnnualSummaryReport supports export to both PDF and XML formats.
CustomerClubGrowthReport offers a monthly overview of new and total club members.
CustomerClubGrowthReport includes data for new members each month, cumulative totals, and growth percentages.
CustomerClubGrowthReport can order the report by month in ascending order.
